_comment: Components of Any360 by stage (docs/DESIGN.md section 1) and their state, kept by hand; tools/progress_page.py reads it. States: done (in this repository, usable by a title), in progress, planned, game-specific (stays in the title's repository; listed so the boundary is visible). 'source' is where the component exists today.

components.name: Pinned ReXGlue baseline (v0.10.0) and patch application rules
components.note: the scaffold stays fast and correct while stages 1-3 are built on it

components.name: SDK patch series: kernel fixes, threading and clock, audio, input, GPU shared, Vulkan, D3D12, codegen (120 patches)
components.note: candidates for ReXGlue upstream; the codegen patches (0005, 0052, 0095) fix rounding the oracle must get right

components.name: Coverage: imports and instructions a title needs vs what the runtime provides
components.note: run on Crackdown and The Simpsons Game

components.name: GPU feature census from a running title (PM4 opcodes, shader families, formats, MSAA, memexport, queries)
components.note: what the coverage tool cannot see statically

components.name: Patch inventory and progress page
Crash mapping: host crash address to guest function and instruction
Threads, synchronisation, APCs, timers with Xbox semantics (~60 imports)
components.source: to write; reference: rexruntime src/kernel/xboxkrnl_threading.cpp + Crackdown patches 0015-0021, 0026, 0068
components.note: first any360::sys slice (L5)

components.name: Files, saves, DLC: VFS over installed data, STFS / XContent packages (~40 imports)
components.source: to write; crackdown has src/stfs.cpp, src/xdvdfs.cpp, src/content_*.cpp (game-side today)
components.note: Crackdown's STFS and XDVDFS readers are already native and generic

components.name: Audio: XMA decoder and platform mixer (~20 imports)
components.source: to write; Simpsons drives XMA contexts through the kernel API

components.name: Input, user profiles, offline achievements, UI dialogs, Live offline answers (~100 imports)
HLE frame ABI: rex_gpu_hle_submit_frame(const HleFrameAbi*), version 4
components.note: the contract between records and renderer while the renderer lives in the plugin

components.name: Draw record model: RecordKind, DrawRecord, shared immutable state blocks
components.note: source-agnostic: filled by XDK hooks (Crackdown) or by a PM4 decode (Simpsons plan)

components.name: PM4 decoder: Xenos packets to state writes, draws, shader loads, bin predication, indirect buffers
components.note: header-only, no game knowledge

components.name: Native pass pipeline: records to pipelines, native draw, comparison with the emulated target
components.note: shadow atlas exact for static geometry (2026-10-29); 1 of 29 passes

components.name: Render pass markers and per-pass accounting
components.note: pass ids and names come from the title

components.name: XDK D3D runtime binding by signature (roles: draw, clear, resolve, RunCommandBuffer, GPR flush, shader bind)
components.source: crackdown: docs/progress/d3d_entry_points.txt (209 addresses); simpsons: re/d3d_method_table.md (174 signature matches)
components.note: hashes and roles only; makes the hooks portable between titles of the same XDK

components.name: Symbol recovery: functions, vtables, RTTI class names, call graph, strings, data layout (REA on the decrypted image)
components.source: crackdown: tools/find-missing-functions.py, guest-graph, re/; simpsons: libtrap + functions_patch.toml
components.note: output is a symbol map (address, name, class, module) kept in the title's repository

components.name: Library recognition: XDK D3D, Havok, XAudio2, CRT, zlib by signature; replaced, not decompiled
components.note: Havok 4.x decompiled once and shared by the titles that ship it

components.name: Guest sandbox: run recompiled functions outside the game in a lazily committed 4 GB guest space, golden inputs / outputs
components.note: leaf functions today; non-leaf functions and memory snapshots next

components.name: Decompile + bind + verify pipeline: Ghidra PowerPC output cleaned with recovered types, bound over sub_X, proven against the oracle
components.source: crackdown: src/guest_binding.h (CRACKDOWN_BIND, 103 functions bound by hand)
components.note: stage 2 progress = verified native functions / total, per module

components.name: SDK patch guards and ABI equality tests
Platform layer: SDL3 window / input / audio, file system, clock
components.note: Windows, Linux / Steam Deck, macOS, Android

components.name: Renderer backends beyond Vulkan: Metal via MoltenVK, WebGPU for WebAssembly
Asset conversion at install: big-endian data to host formats, so no guest memory remains
components.source: crackdown: launcher installs from ISO (src/content_install.cpp, tools/xiso_extract.py)
components.note: the step that unlocks ARM64 and WebAssembly fully

components.name: Render pass hooks and names, import binding table, settings, launcher, achievements, cheats, save compatibility, title updates
components.note: stays in each title's repository

components.name: Reconstructed source and symbol map of the title, its goldens
components.note: Any360 never holds a title's code or data
